create_DeepNeurdModel: create a DeepNeurdModel neural network for solving a game with configurable hidden layers and skip connections
build_CounterfactualNeurdSolver: build a CounterfactualNeurdSolver with a game and per-player models for counterfactual regret minimization
test_neurd_training: test the NeuRD training loop by evaluating and updating policies over multiple iterations on kuhn_poker
train_NeurdModel: train a NeuRD model on data with configurable batch size, step size, and autoencoder loss function
call_thresholded: call the thresholded function to clamp regrets based on logits within a specified threshold range
